title: Metastable opinion dynamics with hidden preferences: an Ising model with neutral agents
summary: We introduce a new Ising-type framework for opinion dynamics that explicitly separates private preferences from publicly expressed binary opinions and naturally incorporates neutral agents. Each individual is endowed with an immutable hidden preference, while public opinions evolve through Metropolis dynamics on a finite graph. This formulation extends classical sociophysical Ising models by capturing the tension between internal conviction, social conformity, and neutrality.
